sections.title: Reading — Task 1: Tasks
sections.instructions: Read the passage, then answer the questions.

questions.prompt: The line graph below shows the number of annual visits to Australia by overseas residents. The table below gives information on the country of origin where the visitors came from. Write a report for a university lecturer describing the information given. Write at least 150 words.

Some countries encourage teenagers to have part-time job and see it as a good thing, while others disagree. Give your opinion and explain both views. Write at least 250 words. Cambridge IELTS Tests 1 to 17
